from openpyxl import load_workbook
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
import re

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/50630/1_50630_input.xlsx")

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Fill only the requested answer range: C5:E6
for row in range(5, 7):
    sentence = ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value or ""
    sentence = str(sentence).replace("\xa0", " ").strip()
    
    # Split using "Added" and "Due"
    match = re.match(r"^(.*?)\s+Added\s+(.*?)\s+Due\s+(.*?)$", sentence, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if match:
        name = match.group(1).strip()
        added_text = match.group(2).strip()
        due_text = match.group(3).strip()
        
        # Write literal values into C:E only
        ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value = name
        ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value = added_text
        
        try:
            ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value = datetime.strptime(due_text, "%d %b %Y")
        except ValueError:
            ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value = due_text

wb.save(output_path)
